questions.question: The apostle Paul weighed our present sufferings against the glory that will be revealed in us. What did he conclude?

answers.text: The sufferings are not comparable to the glory
The sufferings are about equal to the glory
The sufferings will last longer than the glory

questions.question: The apostle Paul said we do not always know how to pray. How does the Holy Spirit speak to God for us?

answers.text: With groans too deep for words
With songs of praise in heaven
With the words of the prophets

questions.question: The apostle Paul said God works all things together for the good of those who love Him. True or false?
The apostle Paul wrote that God predestined those He foreknew. What did He predestine them for?

answers.text: To be conformed to the image of His Son
To be made servants in His Son's kingdom
To be set as priests in His holy temple
